summary: Canaan Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing open-market share purchases by its CEO and CFO, who together acquired 1,065,000 ADSs at an average price of $0.35 per ADS. The purchases were made in compliance with internal trading policies and applicable regulations; no tender offer, issuer buyback program, or special-committee review was announced. The filing is a routine current report disclosing insider transactions intended to signal alignment with shareholders, not a special situation such as a capital return, going-private, or other corporate event. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are noted. Nothing further to watch from a risk-arb perspective.
